name: activation-poc
description: POC de activación de servicios con Kafka, NestJS y React

scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @poc/contracts && npm run build -w @poc/kafka-toolkit
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @poc/activation-api && npm run build -w @poc/billing-service && npm run build -w @poc/provisioning-service && npm run build -w @poc/notification-service && npm run build -w @poc/crm-analytics-service && npm run build -w @poc/loyalty-service && npm run build -w @poc/demo-ui
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d kafka kafka-init kafka-ui mongo mongo-init mailhog
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @poc/activation-api
